checks.message: Verify Inspector v2 is enabled for all required scan types
checks.context: Inspector v2 supports EC2, ECR, and Lambda scan types. Omitting a scan type from --resource-types means those resources are never scanned for vulnerabilities. Enable all relevant types: EC2, ECR, LAMBDA.

checks.message: Verify you are not suppressing findings that cover production resources
checks.context: Inspector v2 suppression filters can silently hide active vulnerabilities. Narrowing filter criteria (by account, region, or resource tag) means matching findings are suppressed and will not appear in your dashboard or trigger alerts.
